_doc: LR-158: talking over remembered moments (src/sim/memory_talk.hpp). memory.moment.<type> - the moment in the first person ({moment}), memory.shared.<type> - 'we' ({moment_we}), memory.when.<bucket> ({when}).
memory.moment.ate_seed_corn: I had to eat the seed corn
memory.moment.was_comforted: someone comforted me in a hard hour
memory.moment.was_given_food: someone fed me when there was nothing to eat
memory.moment.breakthrough: I made a breakthrough in my work
memory.moment.buried: I buried one of my own
memory.moment.migrated: I left my old home and came here
memory.moment.proposed: I asked for a hand in marriage
memory.moment.sworn_friend: I swore brotherhood with a friend
memory.moment.saw_punishment: I saw a punishment carried out
memory.moment.saw_attack: I saw a man beaten before my eyes
memory.moment.attacked_by_undead: a dead thing came for me
memory.moment.saw_beast: I saw a beast right by the village
memory.shared.saw_beast: we saw a beast by the village
memory.moment.saw_magic: I saw magic with my own eyes
memory.moment.good_hunt: I came back from the hunt with rich game
memory.shared.good_hunt: we came back with rich game
memory.moment.was_spared: I was spared in a fight
memory.moment.rescued_someone: I pulled someone out of trouble
memory.moment.was_released: I was let go from captivity
memory.moment.exiled: I was driven out of my home
memory.moment.made_tool: I made myself a new tool
memory.moment.with_child: we're expecting a child in the family
memory.moment.stranger_arrived: a stranger came to stay with us
say.memory.ask_memory: Tell me, {listener}, what has stayed with you?
say.memory.no_moment: A life like any other, nothing much to tell.
say.memory.recall: You know, {listener}, {when} {moment}. I still remember it.
say.memory.recall.sad: I can't get it out of my head: {when} {moment}.
say.memory.recall.glad: I had a joy of my own: {when} {moment}!
say.memory.recall.alarm: Would you believe it, {when} {moment}. Barely came out alive.
say.memory.recall.shame: I'm ashamed to say it, but {when} {moment}.
say.memory.recall.type.attacked_by_beast: {when_up} a beast leapt at me out of the thicket. I thought that was the end.
See this, {listener}? A beast clawed me {when}. Barely fought it off.
say.memory.recall.type.attacked_by_undea: {when_up} a dead thing came for me. Cold, with empty eyes... not a thing to speak of at night.
The dead don't always lie still, {listener}. I learned that myself {when}.
say.memory.recall.type.starved: {when_up} I was so hungry I'd have gnawed bark.
Do you know what hunger is, {listener}? I learned it {when}.
say.memory.recall.type.wedding: {when_up} I was wed. The best day, what more is there to say.
I keep thinking of my wedding, {listener}. What a feast that was!
say.memory.recall.type.built_home: I raised my house {when}. Every log with my own hands.
A roof of your own, {listener}, is no small thing. I raised my house {when}.
say.memory.recall.type.raided: {when_up} raiders fell on us. Smoke, screams... I won't forget.
I remember that raid, {listener}. They carried off our goods and beat our people.
say.memory.recall.type.won_fight: {when_up} I won a fight. My hand never wavered!
I held my ground in a fight {when}, {listener}, and won.
say.memory.recall.type.maimed: See, {listener}? I was maimed {when}. That's how I've been since.
I'm not as strong as I was. I was maimed {when}.
say.memory.recall.type.buried: {when_up} I laid one of my own in the ground. It's empty without them.
It weighs on me, {listener}. I buried one of my own {when}.
say.memory.recall.type.rescued: I was rescued from captivity {when}. I'll be grateful all my life.
I thought I'd never be free again, but I was rescued {when}.
say.memory.recall.type.escaped: {when_up} I escaped captivity. At night, through the woods, barefoot.
They couldn't hold me, {listener}! I escaped {when}.
say.memory.recall.type.exiled: I was driven from my home {when}. I've wandered ever since.
I have no home any more, {listener}. I was exiled {when}.
say.memory.recall.type.saw_necromancy: {when_up} I saw the dead raised. Gods spare me from seeing it again.
Some things are better not seen, {listener}. {when_up} I saw a corpse raised.
say.memory.recall.type.good_hunt: {when_up} I brought such game back from the hunt that the whole family ate for a week!
That was a fine hunt {when}, {listener}. The beast walked right up to me.
say.memory.recall.type.breakthrough: {when_up} it all came together in my work — I finally understood how!
I struggled with it a long time, {listener}. And {when} it suddenly worked.
say.memory.recall.with.fight: {when_up} {with} and I came to blows. {moment_up}, that's how it was.
say.memory.recall.with.wedding: {when_up} {with} and I were wed. The best day, what more to say.
I keep thinking of my wedding with {with}. What a feast!
say.memory.recall.with.kindness: {with} helped me out {when}. I won't forget it.
There are good people, {listener}. {when_up} {with} helped me.
say.memory.recall.with_dead: I remember, {when} {moment}. And {with} is in the ground now, gods rest them.
say.memory.recall.with_us.kindness: I haven't forgotten, {listener}: you helped me out {when}.
Thank you again, {listener}. I remember how you helped me {when}.
say.memory.recall.with_us.shame: I remember, {listener}, how you shamed me {when}.
I haven't forgotten what happened {when}, {listener}. You know what I mean.
say.memory.reminisce.sad: Do you remember, {listener}, how {when} {moment_we}? Gods keep it from happening again.
say.memory.reminisce.glad: Do you remember, {listener}, how {when} {moment_we}? Good days!
say.memory.reminisce.alarm: Remember when {moment_we}? We barely made it.
Do you remember, {listener}, how {when} {moment_we}? My hands still shake.
say.memory.reminisce.proud: Remember when {moment_we}? Something to be proud of.
say.memory.reminisce.eerie: Remember when {moment_we}? Brr, it still unsettles me.
Do you remember, {listener}, how {when} {moment_we}? Not a thing to speak of at night.
say.memory.reminisce.spicy: Do you remember, {listener}, how {when} {moment_we}? The whole village talked of it.
say.memory.reminisce.type.wedding: Do you remember our wedding, {listener}? What a feast!
Remember the wedding {when}? There was no better day.
say.memory.reminisce.type.built_home: Remember, {listener}, how we raised the house? Our backs ached for days.
There it stands, our house. Remember hauling the logs {when}?
say.memory.react.alarm: How dreadful! Good thing you're whole.
Oh my! Take care from now on.
say.memory.react.eerie: Spit over your shoulder — not a thing for the night.
Brr... don't tell such things at night.
say.memory.react.shame: Let it go, {listener}, it's in the past.
say.memory.react.same: The same happened to me, {listener}. I know what it's like.
I went through it myself, I understand you.
say.memory.react.with_us.kindness: Oh, it was nothing, we look after our own.
Think nothing of it, {listener}. You'd have done the same.
say.memory.react.with_us.shame: What's done is done. You brought it on yourself.
You keep raking up the past, {listener}.
say.memory.react_reminisce.sad: How could I forget. It was hard.
say.memory.react_reminisce.glad: Of course! Those were good times.
say.memory.react_reminisce.alarm: I remember. Frightening to think of.
say.memory.react_reminisce.proud: I remember! We did well then.
Indeed! Something to tell the grandchildren.
say.memory.react_reminisce.eerie: Don't remind me, it still unsettles me.
say.memory.react_reminisce.spicy: Oh, it makes me laugh to think of it.
say.memory.react_reminisce.with_dead: I remember... a pity {with} didn't live to see today.
I remember. {with} was with us then, gods rest them.
